Chapter 695: Chapter 6 Exaggerated Accumulation Speed Of World-Breaking Origin Force (Subscription Request)

Chapter 695: Chapter 6 Exaggerated Accumulation Speed of World-Breaking Origin Force (Subscription Request)

“There was a tremor?”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was astonished. These kinds of heritage stars were divided into three types.

Ninth Rank Spatial Heritage Star, Tenth Rank Fusion Rule Heritage Star, Eleventh Rank Fusion Rule Heritage Star.

The black planet was a Tenth Rank Fusion Rule Heritage Star, which only allowed Tenth Rank Life to enter.

Besides understanding the corresponding Pillar-level Fusion Rules, it also had intrinsic requirements for life level—higher Eleventh-Rank Life or lower Ninth Rank Life did not qualify.

Given the ‘weight’ of the Tenth Rank Fusion Rule Heritage Star, if it were in the external world, even an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse could not budge it by an inch.

...

If it were inside? An attack of an Eleventh Rank level could potentially have an impact, but that introduces a paradox.

That is, Tenth Rank Fusion Rule Heritage Star does not allow Eleventh-Rank Life to enter.

Eleventh-Rank Life cannot enter, and Tenth Rank Life is far too inferior to Eleventh Rank Life.

Furthermore, the heritage space inside the heritage star suppresses other rule fluctuations, only allowing the operation of corresponding fusion rules. External forces, secret treasures, and other methods are all useless—

this makes each heritage star extremely stable, not subject to changes due to external forces.

Therefore, Xia Qin Supreme Being was a bit astonished.

“Let me take a look.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s thoughts stirred slightly.

An incarnation immediately descended outside the black planet.

At the same time.

Centered on the black planet, the time over millions of miles’ range suddenly began to ‘reverse.’

It was as if a scene playing at ‘normal speed’ suddenly started to ‘rewind.’

Time reversal.

This was a secret technique that any life that thoroughly understood the Rule of Time could perform.

However, even for Lin Yuan, the area of his time reversal was at most tens to hundreds of miles.

Any more would be too much to handle, yet the time reversal area of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being spanned tens of millions of miles.

And this was still just an insignificant incarnation of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, who could have as many such incarnations as she wanted within the territorial scope of Human Civilization under the coverage of the virtual networks.

“Indeed, there was a tremor.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being nodded slightly. Through the time reversal, she also discovered that a minor tremor had occurred in the black planet.

“Why is that so?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being was somewhat surprised.

The possibilities could be merely one of two.

One is that there might have been an issue or an accident with the operation itself inside the black planet.

The other possibility is that a powerhouse within the internal heritage space of the black planet unleashed an Eleventh-Rank level attack, exceeding the internal thresholds of the black planet, thus causing the recent incident.

The first possibility remains unspoken for now.

The second possibility? At present, Lin Yuan is the only person inside the heritage space of the black planet.

That is to say, if this possibility is true, then the person who unleashed the Eleventh-Rank attack is Lin Yuan.

But how is that possible?

If the gap between Eighth Layer and Ninth Rank is one, then the gap between Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank is a hundred, and between Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank, it’s ten thousand to a hundred thousand.

Fighting beyond one’s rank?

At the Third Rank, Fourth Rank, and Fifth Rank, it might be realized by relying on one’s own bloodline physique, mastery of secret techniques, and so on.

But the higher the realm, the less likely such an event occurs, until it becomes impossible.

Both Supreme Beings knew that when Lin Yuan broke through to Tenth Rank, he had endured the massive infusion of Chaos Void Origin, gaining tremendous benefits.

But even significant benefits cannot change the fact that Lin Yuan is Tenth Rank Life.

Perhaps with Lin Yuan’s talent and having endured so much Chaos Void Origin Infusion, training to the peak of Tenth Rank, he might hope to elevate his attack ability to the threshold of Eleventh Rank.

But how long has it been?

A normal newcomer to Tenth Rank as an evolver is still not completely accustomed to his newly increased power, yet Lin Yuan’s attack has reached the threshold of Eleventh Rank?

“This young fellow…” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being shook her head slightly.

Ever since the two of them started paying attention to Lin Yuan, the frequency of their surprises almost matched the total of the past several million to tens of millions of years.

Human Civilization in the Starry Sea Era has only extended over slightly more than two million years, but before the Starry Sea Era, there were long periods of dormancy.

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly Supreme Being were naturally far older than two million years; they were born before the long periods of dormancy.

…

Inside the black planet.

Within the vast universe.

The man in the black robe blankly stared at the terrifying scene caused by Lin Yuan’s strike.

The Power of Life and Death Samsara, exuding strands of terrifying aura, constantly spread towards the outside world along the holes, even distorting and erasing the space under its influence.

“Is this the newly comprehended Life and Death Samsara Rule?”

The man in the black robe was silent for a long time, “At least it matches the Life and Death Samsara Rule of the Second Realm or even the Third Realm.”

The man in the black robe’s gaze shifted, looking at Lin Yuan, who dealt the recent strike, his mind replaying numerous scenes.

As the Altar Spirit, he had absolute control over this space.

The Life and Death Samsara Rule operated by Lin Yuan was indeed newly comprehended, merely at the early stage of the First Realm.

Whether it’s an ordinary Fusion Rule or a Pillar-level Fusion Rule, based on the depth of comprehension, it is divided from the First Realm to the Ninth Realm.

For a Tenth Rank Evolver to break through to Tier 11, the threshold is at least to comprehend one Pillar-level Fusion Rule and cultivate this rule to the Second Realm.

The understanding of rules is extremely difficult, let alone the fusion of rules.

If understanding the inherent rules of the universe, one just needs to quietly comprehend the fluctuations of the rules.
